title: Alibi and Autopsy Revisited
author: Emrys Hartwell
blurb: Ulyana Reyes, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
